claims.evidence: The witness identified the items as game consoles but did not read a brand or model from the units.
The origin and usage history of the consoles cannot be determined through photos.
The witness explicitly noted that controllers, power cables, and HDMI cables were not shown.
The witness could not verify the internal storage capacity or the presence of digital/physical games.

risks.risk: The consoles may have hardware failures like the 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD).
risks.proof: A video showing the consoles booting up to the PlayStation home screen.

risks.risk: The optical disc drives may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized by the system, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive

risks.risk: The 'complete accessories' may be missing or low-quality third-party replacements.
risks.proof: A clear photo of all included controllers and cables.

risks.risk: The internal storage might be the base 500GB version without the claimed games.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Storage' section in the system settings.
risks.if_unproven: as a base 500GB model with no games

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker (e.g., CUH-10xx, 11xx, or 12xx) on the back or bottom of the consoles.
Video showing both consoles powered on and displaying the system menu on a TV.
Photo of all accessories (controllers, power cords, HDMI cables) mentioned by the seller.
Screenshot of the 'Library' or 'Storage' menu showing the 7 installed games.
response.reason: The witness was unable to confirm the specific brand or model of the consoles, and no accessories or functional tests were provided to support the seller's claims.
